_comment: Options kernel-hardening-checker reports as FAIL that this platform accepts, each with the reason. Regenerate with scripts/ci/khc-gate.py --update, then fill in every empty reason.

accepted_failures.CONFIG_ACPI_TABLE_UPGRADE: Fixable: disable CONFIG_ACPI; the board boots with a device tree. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_AIO: Fixable: unset; no consumer of the legacy aio interface. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_ARCH_MMAP_RND_BITS: Fixable: set to ARCH_MMAP_RND_BITS_MAX (33). Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_ARCH_MMAP_RND_COMPAT_BITS: Fixable: follows from unsetting COMPAT. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_ARM64_BTI_KERNEL: Cortex-A55/A76 (ARMv8.2) have no BTI; the symbol is not offered in this configuration and would be inert.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_ARM64_SW_TTBR0_PAN: Software PAN emulation for CPUs without PAN; this CPU has hardware PAN (ARM64_PAN=y).
accepted_failures.CONFIG_BLK_DEV_WRITE_MOUNTED: Fixable: unset; RAUC writes the inactive unmounted slot, the verity root is read-only. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_BPF_SYSCALL: systemd and the BPF LSM use it; BPF_UNPRIV_DEFAULT_OFF=y.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_CACHESTAT_SYSCALL: Fixable: unset; no consumer. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_CFI_CLANG: Clang-only; the kernel is built with GCC 15.3.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_CFI_PERMISSIVE: Clang-only; the kernel is built with GCC 15.3.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_CHECKPOINT_RESTORE: Fixable: unset; container checkpointing is not used. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_COMPAT: Fixable: unset; no 32-bit userspace in this distro. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_COREDUMP: Fixable: unset in prod; dev tier keeps core dumps. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_CORESIGHT: Fixable: unset; CoreSight trace hardware debugging is not used in prod. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_DEBUG_FS: Fixable: unset in prod after confirming the accelerator driver and smoke test read nothing from debugfs. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_DEFAULT_MMAP_MIN_ADDR: Fixable: follows from unsetting COMPAT. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_DEVMEM: Kept for devmem2 on the bench with STRICT_DEVMEM=y and IO_STRICT_DEVMEM=y (security-hardening.cfg); candidate to drop in prod.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_EFI_CUSTOM_SSDT_OVERLAYS: Fixable: disable CONFIG_EFI; no EFI firmware path on this board. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_EFI_DISABLE_PCI_DMA: Fixable: disable CONFIG_EFI; the board boots TF-A/firmware -> U-Boot -> signed FIT, no EFI firmware. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_FB: VT_CONSOLE on HDMI and fbdev emulation for DRM; whether a prod appliance needs a text console is an open product decision.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_GCC_PLUGIN_LATENT_ENTROPY: Fixable: enable; GCC_PLUGINS=y. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_INET_DIAG: ss and systemd-networkd socket diagnostics; candidate to drop in prod.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_IO_URING: Fixable: unset; podman/crun and systemd do not require io_uring. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KALLSYMS: Oops decoding, perf and BPF kprobes need symbol names. KALLSYMS_ALL is the broader exposure, candidate to drop in prod.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KASAN_HW_TAGS: Needs MTE hardware (ARMv8.5); absent on this SoC. Debug instrumentation, not for prod.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KCMP: Fixable: unset; only CRIU uses kcmp. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KSTACK_ERASE: Fixable: GCC_PLUGIN_STACKLEAK=y on 6.12 (the checker accepts either name), KSTACK_ERASE=y on 6.18. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KSTACK_ERASE_METRICS: Resolved with KSTACK_ERASE / GCC_PLUGIN_STACKLEAK: unset once stack erase is enabled.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_KSTACK_ERASE_RUNTIME_DISABLE: Resolved with KSTACK_ERASE / GCC_PLUGIN_STACKLEAK: unset once stack erase is enabled.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_LOCK_DOWN_KERNEL_FORCE_CONFIDENTI: Lockdown LSM is built, mode NONE; integrity mode via the signed cmdline is the planned step. Confidentiality also blocks /dev/mem, kprobes, debugfs and BPF kernel reads.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_LSM_MMAP_MIN_ADDR: Fixable: follows from unsetting COMPAT. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_MAGIC_SYSRQ: Fixable: unset in prod; dev tier keeps SysRq. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_MAGIC_SYSRQ_SERIAL: Fixable: unset in prod; dev tier keeps SysRq. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_MODULES: Accelerator and vendor drivers are modules; MODULE_SIG_FORCE=y refuses unsigned ones.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_PROC_PAGE_MONITOR: /proc/PID/pagemap and smaps for memory tooling; candidate to drop in prod.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_RANDSTRUCT_FULL: Fixable: enable and boot-test; GCC plugin available, every module is built against this kernel's seed. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_RESET_ATTACK_MITIGATION: Fixable: disable CONFIG_EFI; no EFI firmware path on this board. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_RODATA_FULL_DEFAULT_ENABLED: Symbol absent from the 6.18 configuration; rodata=full is the arm64 default. Verify against arch/arm64/Kconfig at the next kernel bump.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_RSEQ: glibc registers rseq for scheduler-aware fast paths; disabling costs performance for no exploit-surface gain measured here.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_SCHED_CORE: Core scheduling needs SMT siblings; this CPU has no SMT, the option is inert.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_SECURITY_SELINUX_BOOTPARAM: Fixable: unset in prod; the cmdline is inside the signed FIT so selinux=0 is not a usable escape. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_SECURITY_SELINUX_DEVELOP: Permissive-mode support stays until the SELinux enforcing campaign passes on both boards.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_SHADOW_CALL_STACK: Fixable: enable and boot-test; CC_HAVE_SHADOW_CALL_STACK=y, out-of-tree modules build against the same kernel. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_STATIC_USERMODEHELPER: Needs a single trusted dispatcher binary for every usermode helper; a later hardening step.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_TRIM_UNUSED_KSYMS: Breaks out-of-tree modules (accelerator, vendor media drivers).
accepted_failures.CONFIG_UBSAN_TRAP: Fixable: unset UBSAN_ENUM (enum checks trap on valid code); UBSAN_TRAP=y is already set. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_USER_NS: Rootless Podman (the edge-ctr principal) requires user namespaces.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_VT: Text console on HDMI; whether a prod appliance needs it is an open product decision.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_WERROR: Kernel -Werror off: a distro kernel must survive toolchain updates; warnings are reviewed, not fatal.
accepted_failures.CONFIG_ZERO_CALL_USED_REGS: Fixable: enable; CC_HAS_ZERO_CALL_USED_REGS=y. Accepted at baseline creation 2026-10-05; tracked for the prod kernel fragment.
